sources.fullCitation: Group photograph of members of the Warsaw Philharmonic orchestra, taken to mark the 25th anniversary of the Warsaw Philharmonic. A Blüthner grand piano is visible at right, with the organ in the background. Photographer unknown. Reproduced in „Światowid” no. 45 (1926). Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe (NAC) / Szukaj w Archiwach, unit 5969079, object 333267, former sygn. 1-K-7053. October 1926.
